The         pool prices the multiplier over the position's whole age instead of         the 30 days actually committed: the position's multiplier goes from         1.01x to 3.7154x (virtual stake 4.0399 to 14.8612 stETH on 3.9999         stETH deposited), while an honest staker who locks the same         capital for the same 30 days from today stays at exactly 1.0x. The         excess weight is paid by every other staker through dilution of         the pool's fixed reward stream.         No privileged account is used: the impersonated address is an         ordinary staker acting on its own position (the threat model of         this bug \u2014 any staker can do this).
